name: Hans Herrmann
features: fair skin, mid-brown hair combed back, light eyes, round cheerful face, sturdy compact build, unflappable good humour
bio: A Stuttgart baker's son who drove for Mercedes in 1954-55 and set the fastest lap in France as the youngest man then to do it. He is remembered above all for ducking under a closing level-crossing barrier at Mille Miglia speed. Seventeen years later he gave Porsche its first outright Le Mans win, with Richard Attwood in the 917K in 1970, then retired on the spot as he had promised his wife.
